about_the_game:
The Revenants is not just a survival game, but your story of fighting for life in a ruined world where every step can be deadly. You will have to take control of a group of survivors and lead them through trials and threats, where to survive you need to monitor the main indicators: food, water, health and energy.

Search for resources and items in the world, create the necessary equipment. You will also have to fight hostile mobs, protecting your group. Develop skills, improve survival strategies and prove that you can withstand any threat!

                                                  

You will have to face the harsh realities of survival in a dangerous world. Equip your character with gear and clothing, pick up weapons for protection.

         

Monitor your health: Radiation and negative effects can reduce your chances of survival. Use healing and recovery items to avoid losing health, and monitor your hunger and thirst levels.

        

Manage your energy to avoid fatigue and be prepared for unforeseen circumstances: fractures, loss of limbs and even death of the character can be the result of a wrong decision. Your life depends on your decisions and tactics!

         

                          

You have three slots for equipment. The primary weapon slot can hold both powerful long-barreled and compact short-barreled weapons. The secondary slot is designed for quick access to pistols and submachine guns. And for close combat, prepare sharp knives, axes, a deadly spear or homemade weapons in the melee weapon slot.

name: THE REVENANTS

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 64-bit (7 SP1/8/8.1/10)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Phenom II
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 260 / Radeon HD 4670 1GB / Intel HD 4600
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 64-bit (7 SP1/8/8.1/10)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD FX
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: The Revenants is a turn-based survival game with strategy and RPG elements. How long can you survive? The world is destroyed by nuclear war. Fight for survival and limited resources. Manage the aftermath of survivors exploring an infested city. Your story begins here.
supported_languages: Russian, English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Korean, Japanese
